title: ASSURE-FD: code and partition manifests for certified false-alarm rates in cross-machine bearing fault diagnosis
description: Code and recording-level partition manifests for the paper 'ASSURE-FD: Certified false-alarm rates for cross-machine bearing fault diagnosis through test-time adaptation and conformal risk control'. The system certifies the false-alarm rate of a fault-diagnosis model on a newly commissioned machine from its healthy run-in data, combining source-free test-time adaptation with conformal calibration and conformal risk control. Datasets used: CWRU, Paderborn University (KAt), MIMII fan and NASA C-MAPSS (public, not redistributed).
